Privacy notice

For the Law Society ATC Penang website

Information we collect

When you register, we ask for your actual full name, intake or study level, Google account email address, phone number and a public display name. Your posts, comments, reactions and reports are also saved when you use the discussion area.

How we use it

We use these details to manage membership, identify and contact members when needed, provide account access and moderate discussions. Your display name and contributions can be seen by visitors. Your full name, intake, email and phone number are intended for authorised society administrators, not public discussion pages.

Where it is kept

Account and website information are stored using Supabase. The society’s private Google Sheet receives a copy of the four membership fields. The public website is hosted on Vercel. Google handles the Google sign-in process. We do not ask for or store your Google password.

Access and correction

You can update your member details after signing in. Society administrators can review the private register and moderate contributions. To ask about your data or request removal, email lawsocietyatcpg@gmail.com. Removing an account or post may require administrator action and may not remove copies already exported by authorised committee members.

Changes

We may update this notice as the website develops. The current version will be available at this address.
